name: opencore-config-audit
description: Tinjau, ubah, dan rawat konfigurasi OpenCore EFI Hackintosh beserta pemasangan driver-nya: audit BIOS/UEFI, verifikasi per kunci terhadap dokumentasi resmi, inspeksi ACPI/SSDT (AcpiSamples resmi + perpustakaan contoh hotpatch 5T33Z0/OC-Little-Translated), pengoptimalan kext, pembaruan kext dan OpenCore (buktikan dulu pembaruan itu perlu: build yang dikunci installer vendor vs build dari build-repo Dortania), pengumpulan bukti log boot dan waktu boot, alur debug berlapis saat macOS tidak bisa terpasang atau boot, perencanaan peningkatan versi besar macOS (termasuk pembagian versi kext jaringan lewat MinKernel/MaxKernel), pemblokiran disk, serta NVIDIA / Wi-Fi Intel / MediaTek (Sunrise native di macOS 26 + skema kemasan Sunrise Pack MT7922 + fork SimpleMtkWlan) / kartu Broadcom, audio AppleALC (termasuk pemulihan AppleHDA di macOS 26: KDK + MyKextInstaller; layout kustom lewat 5T33Z0/AppleALC-Guides: penyetelan audio runtime dengan alc-verb, tabel MuteGPIO, pengoptimalan hingga 90 KB), HiDPI, Intel Turbo Boost (★ DataProvider terbaik: profil mesin sendiri dengan hwp dihapus), aktif/nonaktifkan E-core pada arsitektur hybrid Intel, pemulihan izin TCC saat AMFI dinonaktifkan (GeekAudio/tcc-helper), nama tampilan CPU (RestrictEvents revcpuname), injeksi memori, tiga kode SMBIOS dan fitur driver/perangkat keras lainnya, serta tampilan antarmuka boot (tema OpenCanopy: set ikon, PickerAttributes, Flavour, label/font/audio/latar belakang).
description_en: Audit, edit and maintain a hackintosh OpenCore EFI configuration and its driver installs: BIOS/UEFI settings audit, per-key verification against the official docs, ACPI/SSDT review against the official AcpiSamples and the 5T33Z0/OC-Little-Translated hotpatch library, kext trimming, deciding whether to update kexts/OpenCore (vendor-pinned vs Dortania build-repo builds), boot-log and boot-timeline forensics, layered debugging when macOS won't install or boot, major macOS upgrade planning (including per-Darwin-version kext gating with MinKernel/MaxKernel), disk masking, plus NVIDIA / Intel WiFi / MediaTek (native Sunrise + MT7922 Sunrise Pack + SimpleMtkWlan fork) / Broadcom cards, AppleALC audio (incl. restoring AppleHDA on macOS 26 via KDK + MyKextInstaller; custom layouts via 5T33Z0/AppleALC-Guides: alc-verb runtime tuning, MuteGPIO table, 90 KB slimming), HiDPI, Intel Turbo Boost (best-practice CPUFriend data: own profile with hwp stripped), Intel hybrid-architecture E-core enable/disable, TCC permission recovery when AMFI is disabled (GeekAudio/tcc-helper), CPU display-name override (RestrictEvents revcpuname), memory injection SMBIOS/serials, and OpenCanopy boot-picker theming.
